verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no documented data-export or account-portability feature for AgentMail, such as bulk export, an mbox/EML download, or an offboarding process. IMAP/SMTP client access, org-wide thread retrieval via the API, and custom domains are adjacent features or developer building blocks a user could use to approximate an export, not the export capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
